What this checks—and what it cannot tell you

This checks only relative center positions and nominal slot widths for named items. A missing-pair plan preserves those values; it is not a manufactured coupon or STL. Numerical comparison tolerance is 0.000000001 mm, solely for floating-point representation—not printer allowance.

It does not check handle envelopes, slot depth or shape, support height, insertion paths, material behavior, printer tolerances, strength, stability or physical fit. Pairwise coverage cannot certify a full assembly. Use an actual measured prototype and appropriate CAD analysis for those questions.

This private prototype uses synthetic workshop items A–D. Prototype limits: 100 items per layout, 200 test pieces, 50,000 pair–test comparisons, coordinates within ±1,000,000 mm. No uploads leave your browser. Export before closing to retain edits.
